name: AWS Organizations Definition
description: Schema defining the structure of an AWS Organization resource, including accounts, organizational units, policies, and the organization hierarchy.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the organization.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name of the organization.

FeatureSet.description: Specifies the functionality available to the organization.

MasterAccountArn.description: The ARN of the management account.

MasterAccountId.description: The unique identifier of the management account.

MasterAccountEmail.description: The email address associated with the management account.

AvailablePolicyTypes.description: A list of policy types enabled for the organization.

Accounts.description: The member accounts in the organization.

OrganizationalUnits.description: The organizational units in the organization.

Policies.description: The policies attached in the organization.

Roots.description: The root containers in the organization.

Account.description: An AWS account that is a member of the organization.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the account.

Email.description: The email address associated with the account.

Name.description: The friendly name of the account.

JoinedMethod.description: The method by which the account joined the organization.

JoinedTimestamp.description: The date the account became a part of the organization.

Account.name: Account

OrganizationalUnit.description: A container for accounts within a root that enables grouping and policy application.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the organizational unit.

Arn.description: The ARN of the organizational unit.

Name.description: The friendly name of the organizational unit.

OrganizationalUnit.name: OrganizationalUnit

Policy.description: A policy that defines controls for your organization.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the policy.

Name.description: The friendly name of the policy.

AwsManaged.description: Whether the policy is an AWS-managed policy.

Content.description: The text content of the policy.

Policy.name: Policy

Root.description: The top-level container in the hierarchy of organizational units.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the root.

Name.description: The friendly name of the root.

Root.name: Root
